seo.description: Meet the team behind Fixture Studio.

props.heading: A small studio with a long view
props.lead: Fixture Studio was founded to make good design straightforward, personal and affordable.

props.heading: Fifteen years of homes, studios and cafés
body: We started as a two-person practice working on family homes. Today we are a team of five, still working from the same small studio on Harbour Lane.
We take on a limited number of projects each year so that every client gets our full attention.

image.alt: A dining table set beside a tall window

props.heading: The people you will work with
props.lead: A small, experienced team who care about getting the details right.

people.name: Hannah Wells
people.bio: Fifteen years designing homes and small workplaces.

people.name: Marcus Lee
people.bio: Keeps every schedule, budget and contractor on track.

people.name: Sofia Alvarez
people.bio: Specialises in materials, colour and lighting.

props.heading: Have a project in mind?
props.lead: Tell us a little about what you have in mind and we will be in touch within two working days.
